subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A strong _________ for mathematics and problem-solving can be very useful.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"aptitude"** means a natural ability to do something or a talent. (प्रवृत्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** She has a remarkable **aptitude** for learning languages quickly.
 
 
 
• **"Aptitude"** refers to a natural talent or ability for a particular skill, making it the most suitable word for the context of having a strong inclination towards mathematics and problem-solving. (प्रवृत्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** His **aptitude** for mathematics was evident from a young age when he solved complex problems with ease.
 
 

Therefore, the correct word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is **'aptitude.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strength** (ताकत): The quality or state of being physically strong.

 
 
• **Example:** His physical **strength** allowed him to lift heavy objects easily.
 
 
 
• **Functioning** (कार्यप्रणाली): The action of functioning or the way something works.
 
 
• **Example:** The** functioning **of the new software was flawless.
 
 
 
• **Perception** (धारणा): The ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **perception **of the situation was quite different from his.
